rule: These sources inform benchmark design and candidate sampling only. No external paper, dataset, replication package, code, result, or label becomes Veritas benchmark gold without artifact-level license review, target-identity review, and independent Veritas adjudication.

sources.name: Read the Paper, Write the Code: Agentic Reproduction of Social-Science Results
useful_design_features: paper-grounded structured method descriptions are prepared outside the coding agent
the coding agent receives structured methods plus original data under information isolation and does not receive the original paper, author code, or original results
post-hoc discrepancy attribution to separate agent errors from paper underspecification or other causes
sources.third_party_artifact_policy: published papers, replication packages, original code, and input datasets are linked rather than redistributed by the upstream release

sources.name: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research
useful_design_features: from-scratch executable replication rather than prose-only assessment
hierarchical decomposition into independently gradable subtasks
rubric construction with paper authors for target fidelity

sources.name: ReplicatorBench
useful_design_features: separate information extraction, research design, execution, interpretation, and validation stages
repository includes benchmark data and result directories
sources.third_party_artifact_policy: repository license does not by itself establish redistribution rights for every embedded paper or third-party input; audit per artifact before copying

sources.name: Polluted IPOs public-history evidence
sources.interpretation: A recent replication-package version does not establish that the underlying paper is a post-training or contamination-reduced holdout.
